title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Four Corner Blobs (Residual-Upsample Width-16)
intuition: Architectural transfer variant of `img_blobs4` replacing transposed convolutions with nearest-neighbor upsampling + width-16 residual Conv2d blocks. Four localized 2x2 bright patches placed in the four corners of an 8x8 canvas. Requires sustained coverage of all 4 corners with >= 90% crisp templates across 5 consecutive terminal checks.
failure_mode: Convolutional generators frequently drop 1-2 corners or drift to a 3-corner equilibrium with blurry double blobs.
protocol_notes: Separate residual-upsample image architecture cohort of `img_blobs4`.
